en.t: This was a textile from Tatsumura.

units.source_text: 太吉郎多次参观过龙村织品展览，还看过原来的古代书画断片和有关目录，

en.t: Takichiro had visited exhibitions of Tatsumura textiles many times, and had also seen the original fragments of ancient calligraphy and paintings, as well as the related catalogs,

units.source_text: 脑子里有印象，都叫得上它们的名字，

en.t: so they had left an impression in his mind, and he could name them all,

units.source_text: 可是他还是一再仔细参观。

en.t: yet he still looked them over carefully again and again.
